subject: Enterprise infrastructure review — scheduling options and proposed agenda
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@healthcore.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthcore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Enterprise infrastructure review — scheduling options and proposed agenda

Hi Sophie and Raj,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning — great to learn more about HealthCore's compliance constraints and the 3 workloads you highlighted (patient indexing, analytics, clinical summarization). Per our discussion, the natural next step is a technical architecture review (VPC/on‑prem options + networking diagram) where we can: 

- Walk through Redwood Private deployment modes and networking patterns we recommend for HIPAA workloads
- Review KV cache behavior and expected latency for the indexing pipeline
- Cover SOC 2 evidence and audit logging controls you asked about

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Jul 13, 15:00–16:00
- Wed Jul 14, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, tell me a couple of times that do and I will coordinate. Suggested attendees from our side: myself (solutions), Marissa (solutions engineering), and Vivek (security/enterprise). If you want to include your infra lead, please add them.

Attached: a short sketch of a recommended architecture and a SOC 2 evidence checklist stub so you can confirm gaps ahead of the call.

Agenda (draft, can be tweaked):
1) 10 min — intro + constraints (HealthCore)
2) 30 min — topology + deployment options + networking details
3) 10 min — compliance, logging, and encryption details
4) 10 min — open questions and next steps / decision points

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Dylan
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Dylan — this is helpful.

Both Raj and I are available Tue Jul 13 at 15:00 PT. Our infra lead (Aisha Rahman) will join as well; copying her on a follow-up invite. Quick notes for the agenda: please include
- a short discussion of key ports and firewall rules we should expect
- any support model differences between Dedicated vs Private deployments

We expect to run the review over Google Meet; can you send a calendar invite with the doc links?

Regards,

Perfect — thanks Sophie. I’ll send the 15:00 PT invite for Tue Jul 13 and include the Meet link plus a short prep doc. Quick additions per your note:

- We will include a slide that lists required ports and recommended CIDR patterns for both VPC-peered and on‑prem VPN setups.
- Marissa will cover the Dedicated vs Private support/SLAs section.

Action items prior to the call:
- Sophie / HealthCore: confirm Aisha’s calendar slot and any compliance evidence you'd like us to review live (e.g., specific audit reports).
- Redwood: calendar invite + Meet link + prep doc (I'll drop a link below).

Calendar invite: Tue Jul 13, 2027 15:00 PT — Duration 60 min
Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/xyz-redwood

If anything changes I’ll update the invite. Looking forward —
